div.div: A single TCP stream grows its congestion window exponentially from a tiny initial size, and any loss halves it.

div.div: The measurement is easy; the statistics are the product. Anyone can divide bytes by seconds — the design work is opening enough streams to reach line rate, ignoring the ramp, and trimming the tails so the number means sustained capacity rather than one lucky 200ms.
